name: OCEANIC-AF
fullName: Asundexian versus Apixaban in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation
population: n=14810, mean 73.9 ± 7.7; 35.2% women, NIHSS mean CHA₂DS₂-VASc 4.3 ± 1.3; 18.2% prior stroke or TIA, stopped prematurely on DMC recommendation
finding: Asundexian markedly WORSE: 1.3% (98 patients) vs 0.4% (26 patients)
teachingPoint: Asundexian is inferior to apixaban for AF stroke prevention (HR 3.79) despite less bleeding — do not substitute it for a DOAC.
